description: List Claude chat sessions. Filter by project (defaults to active); pass include_all=true to list across all projects. Returns at most 50 threads by default (max 200). Each entry has id, title, cwd, project_id, claude_session_id, created_at, updated_at.

project_id.description: Slug of the project to filter by. Omit to use the shell's active project.

name: iyke_session_list
